rowText: After each launch, close the plugin panel and reopen it, then read the status line under the Ask button. It should name the running game, not say 'no active game detected'.

entries.note: Correct on this run. The panel was closed by a QAM chord and reopened by deck_openPlugin (not a plain re-press of the panel button, but the same net effect) after the launch.
